# Fate UI v0.9.8-beta4

Agents can now work in separate local Git worktrees instead of sharing every file in your project. The parent reviews their changes and decides what comes back. Shared checkouts are still the default; nothing gets merged just because an agent says it is finished.

## What's new

- **Optional worktrees for Agent Teams V2.** Choose the workspace per agent, including its base revision and branch, or set defaults for the team. Agents in separate worktrees can write in parallel; writers sharing a checkout still take turns.
- **Workspace review in Run → Agents.** Open an agent's workspace to see its checkout, branch, parent target, diff, and commits. Create a local checkpoint, fast-forward the parent, or cherry-pick selected commits after reviewing them.
- **Explicit cleanup.** Closing or releasing an agent keeps its worktree and branch. Removing a worktree is a separate action that refuses to discard uncommitted work, ignored files, or retained descendant worktrees. The branch stays available.
- **Task statuses are no longer clickable toggles.** The agent updates progress. You can still cancel an ordinary task, but clicking “To do,” “In progress,” or “Blocked” will not change its state.

## Safeguards

Integration checks the reviewed commits and parent branch again before changing files. Checkout locks cover review, integration, cleanup, and worktree creation. Conflicting cherry-pick sequences are aborted rather than leaving an earlier part of the sequence applied.

Worktree sessions inherit the approved root's settings and skill catalog. Git operations disable repository hooks, external filters, custom merge drivers, and signing programs. Restored workspaces are checked against their owner, parent checkout, repository, branch, and original base commit.

## Compatibility

This feature is available in **Agent Teams V2**, not legacy subagent mode. Existing shared-checkout sessions keep their behavior. A worktree isolates checked-out files, not the operating system: **Full access remains unsandboxed**, and unrelated shells or application processes are outside Fate's checkout locks.

See [Agent orchestration](https://github.com/Master0fFate/pi-fategui/blob/v0.9.8-beta4/docs/agent-orchestration.md) for the controls and tool examples.

## Downloads and verification

The release pipeline verifies and smoke-tests native installers on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64 before publishing. Choose the installer for your system below.

Public beta installers are unsigned. Check your download against `SHA256SUMS` and back up important work before upgrading.
